source.task: Japanese 20-choice quiz QA over supplied Wikipedia entity titles
source.dev2_access: defer until Dev1-only selection is frozen; one-time pseudo-test

gates: Dev1 integrity passed; grouped split hashes are frozen
Run the frozen representation/readout comparisons and option-title-only controls on Dev1 only
Review truncation rate, fit history and source-group uncertainty; do not change config after viewing validation results
Freeze one candidate using validation NLL and compare its quality and product-size role before any Dev2 access
Dev2 may be opened once only as a public pseudo-test after selection; it is not a blind audit
Do not download/use non-commercial train questions, Wikipedia article bodies, hidden evaluation data, or sealed audit

dev1_probe_protocol_frozen_before_model_.fit_data: 796 official CC-BY-SA-4.0 Dev1 rows from grouped split; validation is the identical 199 frozen rows for all candidates

candidates.role: in-budget BERT-family candidate; first four pretrained layers only
BERT-base text-only teacher/reference; projected product total exceeds provisional size target

dev1_probe_protocol_frozen_before_model_.input: question paired separately with each supplied candidate title; 20 independent pair encodings per question
dev1_probe_protocol_frozen_before_model_.readout: frozen encoder -> attention-mask mean pool -> shared Linear(hidden,128)-Tanh-Linear(128,1), softmax over 20 options
dev1_probe_protocol_frozen_before_model_.controls: same-encoder option-title-only control for each candidate; question is blank

training.selection: minimum validation NLL among all 100 epochs

dev1_probe_protocol_frozen_before_model_.validation_access: development-only; no Dev2 until candidate and readout selection are frozen
